title: Room booking
brief: A web app where staff book meeting rooms, hosted on Google Cloud Run.

answers.features: Sign in, see rooms by day, book and cancel a slot.
answers.target: Cloud Run behind the team's existing domain; a CI pipeline deploys it.
answers.data: Bookings in Cloud SQL; Google sign-in limited to the company domain.
answers.hosting: New GCP project; region us-central1; small budget.
